- Primary use: document summarization + transaction enrichment in customer workflows.
- Expected initial ingest profile: short prompts with longer system context; avg seq len ~250-500 tokens.
- Key asks: pricing transparency for Private/VPC (licensing + per-token economics), support tiers, and environment count (staging/prod/dev).

- Preferred target $/1M tokens you’re aiming for (this helps us shape options).

- Licensing model options: per-environment license + per-token usage, and an enterprise bundle (license + support + predictable unit cost).
- Recommended support tier for production SLAs (we typically recommend Enterprise 24x7 + on-call for critical production).

Attached: private_vpc_pricing_options.pdf — high-level pricing options and definitions (license, environment, support tiers).

Next steps

Thanks — looping Marissa on technical sizing questions.

Sofia / Liam — thanks for the detail. Attaching a quick ballpark cost model (CSV) and summary in-line so you have something to review with procurement. These are approximate; we’ll convert to a formal quote after you confirm environment count and preferred commitment term.

High-level options (ballpark $/1M tokens and structural notes)
1) Private VPC (license + usage) — recommended for customers that need VPC + on-prem connectivity
   - Licensing: $50,000 / env / year (includes base runtime + admin console)
   - Support: Enterprise 24x7 recommended = $20,000 / year (per customer, not per env)
   - Usage: $750 / 1M tokens (no commitment)
   - Example: 200M tokens => $150,000 usage + license for 3 envs ($150,000) + support ($20,000) = ~$320,000 / month-year pro-rate (we can annualize).

2) Dedicated reserved (pooled reserved capacity) — lower unit cost with a monthly commit
   - Licensing: included in reserved offering (no per-env license fee)
   - Support: Enterprise 24x7 = $20,000 / year
   - Usage (committed tier examples): $450 / 1M tokens with a 12-month commit at 500M/mo equivalent
   - Example: 200M tokens => $90,000 / mo at $450 / 1M; 1B tokens => $450,000 / mo.

3) Enterprise bundle (best for predictable TCO)
   - Annual license + reserved capacity + premium support: effective $/1M can be as low as $350 with a 12–24 month commitment and upfront license.

Notes:
- We can build a hybrid: license private VPC for regulatory needs and route non-sensitive workloads to dedicated pools to lower unit costs.
- Environment licensing is flexible; we can consolidate staging/dev under a single lower-cost env if you prefer.
- All numbers are ballpark — formal SOW/quote will finalize with exact token profiling and sequence-length adjustments.

Attached: cost_model_approx.csv (CSV) — includes line items for 200M / 500M / 1B scenarios across the three options above.

Next step: I’ll prepare a one-page procurement TCO for 200M and 1B scenarios showing annualized cost and recommended option. Can you confirm whether you want the annualized view (preferred by procurement) or monthly run-rate?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
